descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Night Flight is always night. Take off over a whole city lit up below you and land by the runway lights.

A CITY OF LIGHTS
A downtown skyline with lit windows and glowing crowns, a 480 m observation tower, a harbour bridge strung with lights, a Ferris wheel, searchlights and fireworks over the water. Six highways carry thousands of moving cars - white headlights one way, red tail lights the other.

AIRPORTS LIT FOR REAL
Edge and centreline lights, green threshold bars, approach lights with the flashing rabbit, taxiway greens and blues, stop bars, lit signs, a glass terminal with airliners at the gates and a rotating beacon. Your landing lights light up the runway as you flare.

THE NIGHT SKY
Twilight, Moonlit or Starlight: twinkling stars, the Milky Way, the moon, shooting stars, and clouds lit silver by the moon and orange by the city below.

THREE AIRCRAFT
A business jet with a glass cockpit, autopilot and a cabin you can walk through, a helicopter, and a fighter with a head-up display and afterburner. Paint them and power wash them in your hangar.

MISSIONS
City Lights Approach over downtown, the Skyline Run, the Starlight Canyon, a Midnight Arrival, fighter missions and formation flying, plus twelve landmarks to discover.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
